body_mass_source: trial 13 boneid estimate (data/opensim/work/p1_trial13_boneid.npz), same as the trial-13 knee contact
d_ic_note: 40 mm generic x tibia_r uniform scale factor 1.0084 (same as trial 13)

units.s{slot}_total/medial/lateral/lig_lateral: BW (body_mass x 9.80665), NaN outside the SO window
units.s{slot}_knee_flexion_deg: deg, OpenSim knee_angle_r (+ = flexion), 12 Hz low-passed IK
units.s{slot}_knee_adduction_moment: N m, EXTERNAL knee adduction moment (+ = varus) = -M_x of the inertia+gravity+GRF reaction at the knee centre in the tibia frame, NaN outside the SO window. The walker knee has one DOF, so OpenSim ID has no frontal knee coordinate; this is the same frontal-moment definition as trial 13's ext_frontal_moment
units.s{slot}_knee_sagittal_moment: N m, OpenSim ID knee_angle_r_moment (+ = flexion moment, so extension is negative)
units.s{slot}_stance_frames: [n,2] (heel strike, toe off) frame indices on s{slot}_t of complete right stances (Fz > 20 N, lasting >= 0.2 s and peaking >= 0.3 BW) inside the SO window
units.stride_s / step_freq_hz: mean right heel-strike interval over the whole trial; step frequency = 2 / stride

peak_definition: mean over the complete right stances of each stance's maximum; impulse = trapezoid integral over each stance (BW s), mean over stances

settings.model: trial-13 p1_scaled.osim reused (no rescale, no marker re-placement); processed model rebuilt by pipeline.processed_model() from it (DGF rigid tendon, no passive, F-L width x1.5, welded subtalar/mtp/wrist, pelvis residuals 100, 1 N m reserves)
settings.ik: one pass, trial-13 final weights, accuracy 1e-5
settings.so: sum of activation^2, muscle physiology on, convergence 1e-4, max 200 iterations, 12 Hz coordinate low-pass, window 0.10 s to T_end - 0.10 s
settings.contact: knee_contact.knee_wrench + split: subtree Newton-Euler below the knee, two-point medial/lateral split, lateral lift-off clamped and reported as ligament tension

conditions: van der Zee et al. 2022 Table 2: fixed speed 1.25 m/s (belt measured ~1.17 m/s), f* = step frequency / preferred
synthetic: syn<+d>_* keys: slot 19 re-timed by boneid.simulate.step_frequency_trial(trial, k, 85.16) to f0 + d steps/min at the same belt speed (f0 = slot 19's mean right-plate-onset stride, k = (f0 + d)/f0); exported with export_inputs.py --syn-d-spm d and run through the identical IK/ID/SO/contact pipeline. Hip centres (HHR/HHL landmarks) are transformed with the markers. d = +0 reproduces slot 19's inputs to 1e-8 (print rounding).
